name: NavList
description: `NavList` is a vertical navigation primitive for settings and page navigation.

props.name: disableItemGap
props.description: Disable the gap between items when the item gap feature is enabled.

props.name: heading
props.description: Supplies the heading region. Takes precedence over a matching `NavList.Heading` child.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render, so the level fits the surrounding document outline independently of its size.

props.name: visuallyHidden
props.description: Hides the heading visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

props.name: heading
props.description: Supplies the heading region. Takes precedence over a matching `NavList.GroupHeading` child.

props.name: hideDivider
props.description: Removes the divider drawn above the group.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading text for the group. A `NavList.GroupHeading` child takes precedence.

props.name: items
props.description: Items revealed by the button.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the button that reveals more items.

props.name: pages
props.description: Number of reveals needed to show every item. `0` reveals them all at once.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renders a revealed item, in place of the default `NavList.Item`. Spread the item's props to keep focus management.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render, so the level fits the surrounding document outline.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Supplies the trailingAction region. Takes precedence over a matching `NavList.GroupHeading.TrailingAction` child.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: as
props.description:
Renders the action as a button.
Renders the action as a link.

props.name: block
props.description:
Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.
Stretches the link to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description:
Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.
Number shown in a trailing counter.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.
Removes the link from the keyboard order and suppresses ordinary click activation. Its `href` remains available
to browser actions such as opening the link from a context menu.

props.name: href
props.description: Not available on a button action. Use `as="a"` to make the action navigate.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon component to render.
Icon rendered inside the heading's trailing action.

props.name: inactive
props.description:
Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.
Marks the link temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the action, since the icon alone conveys nothing.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line. Defaults to wrapping within `Dialog.Footer`.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.
Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses ordinary click activation. Its `href` remains available
to browser actions such as opening the link from a context menu.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Loading status text. Set to an empty string when an external announcer communicates loading.

props.name: tooltipDirection
props.description: Side and alignment of the tooltip that shows `label` for an icon action.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior. Use `submit` to submit a form.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component supplied by the wrapper.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the item temporarily unavailable and explains why. The item stays reachable.

props.name: tooltipText
props.description: Supplementary text shown in a tooltip when the item is hovered or focused.
